title: Acknowledgement of session.instructions.append
description: Confirms context admission for session.instructions.append. It waits for estimated context injection, so it needs frame progress; it proves neither speech, playback, nor any host action.

event_id.description: Provider-assigned identifier for this server event.

client_event_id.description: The event_id of the broker command this event answers, when the broker supplied one.

start_ms.description: Start of the estimated injection range in milliseconds from the start of the session timeline.

end_ms.description: End of the estimated injection range in milliseconds from the start of the session timeline.
